title: The stupa, an introduction
scope: General Buddhist stupa form, relic/reliquary function and symbolic association with the Buddha
limitations: General South Asian Buddhist-art history, not a site-specific dating or identification tool for a Sri Lankan monument.

title: Mudras in Buddhist art
scope: Buddhist hand gestures as iconographic and narrative signs, including Sri Lankan examples
limitations: A mudra helps identify represented role or episode but does not by itself establish date, workshop, school or provenance.

title: Two Lotuses, from the Bharhut Stupa
author_or_institution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Asian Art
scope: Museum documentation of lotus symbolism in an early Buddhist stupa context and association with enlightenment
limitations: Object-specific evidence from Bharhut, India; supports general iconographic vocabulary, not automatic interpretation of every lotus motif in Sri Lanka.
